violated_contract: The realtime voice spawn_agent schema must not advertise directed local providers (Hermes, OpenClaw) that are not connected. Advertising them makes the model pass provider=hermes (or ask the user to connect Hermes) on ordinary research prompts, even after spawn_agent leaf-falls back.
canonical_prevention: The voice catalog clones spawn_agent parameters and either omits provider (none connected) or restricts its enum to host-derived availableDirectedProviderIds — Mac RealtimeHubTools.openAITools(availableDirectedProviders:) parity. Behavioral tests assert omit-when-empty, enum restriction, and that the shared manifest schema is not mutated.
